events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Vibe
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher track, whether it's an Oasis anthem or a solo banger? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's influential second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, and in the US on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' became an anthem for peace. What does John Lennon's iconic album mean to you?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks the anniversary of Apple unveiling the first iPod. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which took place on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Celebrating the 87th birthday of the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's his most unforgettable role for you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album.' A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived 61 years ago today, showcasing a new depth in their songwriting. Which track defines it for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon passed away on December 8, 1980, leaving an indelible mark on music and culture.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the immense legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?
